✅ **ADR-0031 roadmap complete** — all five tasks are merged to `main`.

| # | Task | PR |
|---|------|----|
| 1 | Spec-define constructs + **representation decision: (B) nested sub-structure** | #1482 |
| 2 | Loop container — engine execution (replaces the no-op stub) | #1482 |
| 3 | Parallel block — implicit-join execution | #1489 |
| 4 | Try/catch/retry — execution | #1499 |
| 5 | BPMN ⇄ constructs mapping (model level) | #1500 |

Also along the way: docs for the constructs + a doc-generator fix (#1497).

**Outcome:** `loop` / `parallel` / `try_catch` are now the native, AI-authored control-flow model — well-formed by construction, validated at `registerFlow()` (single-entry/single-exit regions, acyclic, bounded loop), DAG invariant preserved, all engine-executed. BPMN gateway/boundary/multi-instance is retained for interop and bridged by `automation/bpmn-mapping.ts` (round-trippable via the `osConstruct` marker).

**Deliberately deferred (own issues / repos):**
- BPMN 2.0 **XML** (de)serialization plugin on top of the mapping → #1504 (ADR marks XML "Priority: Low").
- Per-iteration / per-region **step logs** in run observability (`TODO` in `runRegion`) → #1505.
- **Designer rendering** of the nested constructs lives in `../objectui` (out of this repo) — to be tracked there.

Closing as completed.
